Leerlingen spelen, doen het voor en late: Students play, demonstrate and let the computer practise. With Flappy Bird and a racing car, they explore how examples, rewards and selection change performance.
Kan jij een ongetraind AI-model verslaan: Can you beat an untrained AI model? Then let the computer watch you play. Collect examples, train your model and let it practise further with rewards and penalties. Who wins when you play again?
Rijd zelf en bouw een eigen circuit met: Drive yourself and build your own circuit with straights and bends. Combine provided tracks and your circuits in a practice series. Let the cars race: the best models form the basis for new generations. What would Darwin think?
Wanneer flap jij? Probeer een ongetraind: When do you flap? Try to beat an untrained AI model.
Laat de computer meekijken. Train en tes: Let the computer watch. Train and test with one recording, three recordings and then more.
Kies een beloning en een straf. Laat mee: Choose a reward and a penalty. Let several birds practise at once and speed up training.
Speel tegen het startmodel, het model da: Play against the starting model, the model that learned from you and the model that practised itself.
Bestuur de auto, bouw en bewaar je eigen: Drive the car, build and save your own track. Combine circuits in a practice series.
Laat de auto’s dezelfde oefenreeks rijde: Let the cars drive the same practice series. Select the best models and test their offspring on another track.
Voor leerlingen van 13 tot 15 jaar. Begi: For students aged 13 to 15. Start with one button in Flappy Bird and continue with the racing car. Students play, predict, train and compare. No coding is required.
Open de website op een laptop. Een toets: Open the website on a laptop. A keyboard is enough for the exercises.
Wissel spelen en bespreken af. Werk alle: Alternate playing and discussion. Work alone or in pairs.
Hoe veranderen de prestaties als je meer: How does performance change with more examples? How do rewards guide learning?
Waarom rijden niet alle auto’s hetzelfde: Why do the cars not all drive alike? What changes from generation to generation?
Werk blijft in de browser. Bewaar een be: Work stays in the browser. Save a file to continue on another device.
Laat leerlingen eerst voorspellen wie za: First ask students to predict who will win. Then test the models under the same conditions. Discuss what they saw and why results may differ.
Met dit project werk je aan deze doelen: This project addresses these goals from the OECD and European Commission AI Literacy Framework:
Leerlingen volgen hoe voorbeelden en bel: Students follow how examples and rewards change a model and how new generations of cars emerge.
Verzamel één, drie en meer opnamen. Trai: Collect one, three and more recordings. Retrain each time and investigate the effect of the number and choice of examples.
Vergelijk het startmodel, het model dat: Compare the starting model, the model that learned from you and the model that practised itself with the same openings. Test the car on another track too.
Vergelijk de prestaties vóór en na het o: Compare performance before and after practice. Decide whether to try extra examples, more training or a different reward.
